import math
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    m = Model("Facility_Location")
    m.setParam("TimeLimit", 300)

    # Problem Data
    facilities = list(range(16))  # F0..F15
    customers = list(range(38))  # C0..C37

    # Facility coordinates (x, y)
    facility_coords = [(10, 45), (38, 82), (82, 82), (70, 32), (11, 43), (35, 99), (4, 99), (78, 20), (79, 95), (4, 93), (67, 8), (76, 8), (18, 62), (81, 96), (74, 48), (28, 60)]

    # Customer coordinates (x, y)
    customer_coords = [(26, 89), (44, 2), (68, 55), (4, 72), (40, 95), (22, 5), (30, 2), (92, 52), (19, 75), (36, 39), (4, 58), (55, 10), (92, 8), (8, 37), (80, 29), (28, 45), (11, 47), (21, 62), (33, 64), (62, 1), (16, 2), (78, 0), (9, 23), (11, 3), (26, 77), (62, 51), (59, 82), (55, 18), (7, 30), (97, 74), (32, 30), (6, 48), (15, 20), (61, 2), (16, 0), (87, 24), (30, 80), (21, 65)]

    facility_capacities = [186.0, 168.0, 187.0, 199.0, 90.0, 167.0, 129.0, 188.0, 135.0, 99.0, 193.0, 136.0, 161.0, 131.0, 112.0, 197.0]
    customer_demands = [27.0, 10.0, 46.0, 41.0, 33.0, 30.0, 44.0, 32.0, 45.0, 35.0, 44.0, 41.0, 37.0, 21.0, 21.0, 35.0, 49.0, 26.0, 36.0, 35.0, 46.0, 10.0, 26.0, 10.0, 20.0, 31.0, 24.0, 49.0, 45.0, 14.0, 38.0, 22.0, 32.0, 17.0, 25.0, 13.0, 26.0, 17.0]
    fixed_costs = [349.0, 337.0, 303.0, 355.0, 228.0, 193.0, 162.0, 500.0, 167.0, 133.0, 205.0, 194.0, 487.0, 368.0, 122.0, 433.0]
    transport_rate = 0.5  # $/km/unit

    # COMPUTE distance matrix from coordinates (INDUCED COSTS)
    def euclidean_distance(coord1, coord2):
        return math.sqrt((coord1[0] - coord2[0])**2 + (coord1[1] - coord2[1])**2)

    distances = {}
    for i in facilities:
        for j in customers:
            distances[(i, j)] = euclidean_distance(facility_coords[i], customer_coords[j])

    # Decision Variables
    # Open_F{i}: Binary - whether facility i is opened
    open_facility = {}
    for i in facilities:
        open_facility[i] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"Open_F{i}")

    # Ship_F{i}_C{j}: Continuous - units shipped from facility i to customer j
    ship = {}
    for i in facilities:
        for j in customers:
            ship[(i, j)] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Ship_F{i}_C{j}")

    # Objective: Minimize fixed costs + transport costs
    # Transport cost = distance * rate * units shipped
    obj = quicksum(fixed_costs[i] * open_facility[i] for i in facilities)
    obj += quicksum(
        distances[(i, j)] * transport_rate * ship[(i, j)]
        for i in facilities for j in customers
    )
    m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # Demand satisfaction constraints
    for j in customers:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(ship[(i, j)] for i in facilities) >= customer_demands[j],
            name=f"Demand_C{j}"
        )

    # Capacity constraints (can only ship if facility is open)
    for i in facilities:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(ship[(i, j)] for j in customers) <= facility_capacities[i] * open_facility[i],
            name=f"Capacity_F{i}"
        )

    m.optimize()
    return m
